gatewayUrl.title: Guardrail gateway address
gatewayUrl.description: Origin of the gateway, e.g. https://guardrail.example.com

failMode.title: Behaviour when the gateway is unavailable

uploadPolicy.title: Files that cannot be checked
uploadPolicy.description: block (default): stop uploads of files the gateway cannot read (PDF, images, archives); warn: let the user confirm

enabled.title: Check prompts on AI sites
enabled.description: Set to true to stop users from switching the check off
